TRUTH DISCOUNT & SYMMETRY COMPARISONS

Report 3: Truth Discount & Comparisons (Truth Twin − Rumor Twin)

9,984 towns (4,992 Rumor + 4,992 Truth) • 4,992 matched twin pairs • Single Judge: Gemini 3.7 Flash • Clustering: Twin Pair (pair_id)
Dynamic Denominators (Never Hardcoded): Truth Discount = Truth Belief − Rumor Belief. Individual invalid judge rows stay NaN (never zero-imputed, and without dropping valid listeners in the same town). Every table reports the exact non-NaN count (Ment. N for conditional Belief, Valid N for labels/silence, Pairs for matched-pair comparisons) and exact estimator.
